visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Difference Forgets the Negation
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The items only in the first set should be [1,2], but the program prints [3,4].

solution.explanation: Keeping the items for which b.has(x) is true gives the intersection. The difference is the items that are not in the other set, so the condition needs the negation !b.has(x).
